card.name: Prepositions after verbs in scholarly prose
card.fires_on: Small linking words, mostly prepositions like at, in, for, of and to, right after a verb or noun in formal, older-style academic or literary prose. The word that follows is often an abstract noun.

modes.label: Preposition after verb
modes.description: A preposition that completes a verb phrase in essay-style writing.

modes.label: Preposition after noun
modes.description: An 'of' that follows an abstract noun like aim or errors.
modes.example: The aim<< of>> this chapter will be to provide some understanding
